openQuestions: Exact boundaries among named urbanizations, cadastral value zones and morphological transitions still do not coincide cleanly; V0 district/zone polygons remain research approximations.
Current built-height distribution for coastal slabs/towers remains weak: planning maxima in La Veleta/Molino Blanco cannot substitute for a measured current-building survey.
Development-level facade/window/balcony rhythms and material palettes remain under-documented outside the broad municipal landscape descriptions.
Representative villa/terrace compound samples are still needed to quantify how roof, pool, garden-wall and porch treatments vary by individual urbanization without destroying local repetition.
La Hoya, La Manguilla, Los Locos and the port/Eras projects are changing during 2026; future-state planning must continue to be kept separate from completed current form.
The future Museo del Mar y de la Sal at Eras de la Sal is not current built form as of 5 October 2026; the current provisional museum remains at C. Patricio Pérez 10.
Completion and exact current appearance of the Muelle Mínguez recovery works were not independently confirmed in this pass.

The saltworks should be represented as a unique industrial landscape, but exact operational plant geometry/material details remain intentionally unresolved where not necessary for city-scale representation.

The retained baseline building ID bldg-torrevieja-landmark-plaza-constitucion is semantic legacy debt: it came from a place landmark rather than a discrete building. Schema v0.1 has no retired-record state, so it is retained and explicitly downgraded rather than silently deleted.
